result:
The DE March cutoff and JE review is complete and the memo has been submitted. Summary:

**Corrected (with support)**
- **JE-00306** – Reversed JE-00305 (Nordwolke NW-2026-0402, €5,600). The invoice is dated 2026-04-02 with an explicit April 2026 service period, so it was booked a month early. AP needs to re-enter it once April opens.
- **JE-00307** – Booked the €38.50 March bank service charge that appeared on the statement (BT-DE-0051) but was never recorded; matched the bank line to it.

**Escalated (EXC-001)**
- **JE-00298** – €9,999 manual "Umsatzkorrektur Q1" to AR/Subscription Revenue, posted late Sunday night by m.krause with no support, no related customer, and no approval request even though it exceeds the USD 10,000 threshold at the March rate (USD 10,998.90). I did not reverse it, since a reversal would also lack support; I've recommended the controller direct reversal before lock unless valid support is produced.

**Everything else** in DE March (AR, AP, card, payroll) is in the right period, supported, and ties to the bank statement. "AP cutoff review" is marked complete. The memo also notes out-of-scope open items: March depreciation (€1,000) still unbooked, the remaining bank-line matching under the bank rec task, and January-origin AP/AR balances worth aging in the flux review.
